description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseConceptMap' which serves as a superclass for ConceptMap-related classes in the OpenMRS project. It includes common properties such as conceptMapType, creator, changedBy, dateCreated, and dateChanged, with appropriate getter and setter methods, handling date cloning for immutability.

classes.name: BaseConceptMap
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common properties for concept mapping entities, including the concept map type, creator info, changers, and timestamps.

methods.name: getConceptMapType
methods.description: Returns the type of the concept map.

methods.name: setConceptMapType
methods.description: Sets the type of the concept map.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created this object.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created this object.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last modified this object.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last modified this object.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date, returning a clone to preserve immutability.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date with cloning to prevent external modifications.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the last change date, returning a clone to preserve immutability.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the last change date with cloning.
